verdict.rationale: CT Corporation offers compliance and entity-management services, and such a platform could plausibly offer scoped API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes: one was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, and the other was a legacy host whose pages redirect into that blocked host. Neither says anything about API credentials, scoping, or least-privilege keys for agents, so there is no evidence of the capability.
